nodes.klein: to be besmeared. was besmeared (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Is. 44:18 in the phrase טַח מֵרְאוֹת עֵינֵיהֶם (= their eyes have been besmeared so that they do not see).

nodes.g: to stroke, be smeared over, be blinded to sport, take delight in
to cover, purge, make an atonement, make reconciliation, cover over with pitch
